models.trains:
WITH train_base AS (
    SELECT 
        t.id as train_id,
        t.direction
    FROM raw.train t
),
cars_by_train AS (
    SELECT 
        c.train_id,
        COUNT(*) as car_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.len = 'long' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as long_car_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.position = 3 AND c.sides = 'double' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as double_sided_3rd_pos,
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.position = 1 AND c.shape = 'rectangle' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as rectangular_head,
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.roof = 'open' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as open_roof_count
    FROM raw.cars c
    GROUP BY c.train_id
)
SELECT 
    tb.train_id,
    tb.direction,
    CASE WHEN tb.direction = 'east' AND cbt.car_count < 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as run_east_and_has_less_than_4_cars,
    CASE WHEN cbt.long_car_count > 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as has_more_than_2_long_cars,
    CASE WHEN cbt.double_sided_3rd_pos = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as has_double_sided_cars_in_3rd_position,
    CASE WHEN cbt.rectangular_head = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as has_rectangular_shaped_head_cars,
    COALESCE(CAST(cbt.open_roof_count AS BIGINT), 0) as number_of_open_roof_car
FROM train_base tb
JOIN cars_by_train cbt ON tb.train_id = cbt.train_id
